thesis: One exact conversation remains canonically addressable while signal extraction, human annotation, obligation state, response coverage, bounded explicit email release and exact transport evidence remain unequal projections beside it.

source_model.identity: SHA-256 of exact pasted source text in browser
source_model.address: message id + clause id + exact character [start,end) range

projections: single-message SOURCE FOVEA with clause addresses
OBLIGATION LATTICE: ASK / PROMISE / DECISION / WAITING / CONSTRAINT / NOTE
response/handoff lane with explicit coverage state
source-bearing RETURN import/resume restores exact thread, human marks, states, response and coverage

provenance_classes.DERIVED: weak deterministic heuristic suggestion; confidence < 1; never human intent truth
provenance_classes.MACHINE: machine-spotted claim about an exact source range at high confidence (< 1); never authored; becomes HUMAN only by explicit CONFIRM at confidence 1, or retires to state DROPPED by explicit DISMISS
provenance_classes.HUMAN: explicit authored mark at exact source range; confidence 1

laws: SOURCE THREAD != DERIVED SIGNALS != HUMAN MARKS != RESPONSE
EVERY PROMOTED COMMS ITEM RETURNS TO AN EXACT SOURCE RANGE
SESSION-ONLY BY DEFAULT; LOCAL PIN IS EXPLICIT
NO SILENT OR DELEGATED SEND AUTHORITY
HUMAN_RELEASE IS ONE EXACT PAYLOAD + ONE EXACT DESTINATION; NO RETRY / EDIT / FORWARD INHERITANCE
SENT_CONFIRMED REQUIRES AN EXACT MATCHING PROVIDER RECEIPT
TRANSPORT EVIDENCE ≠ NATIVE COMMS STATE MUTATION

interaction.non_scroll_primary: whole thread is compressed into a horizontal spine; primary reading surface holds one addressed turn at a time
interaction.address_navigation: turn spine, previous/next keys, LOCATE from any signal
interaction.machine_spot_resolution: MACHINE items expose exactly two resolving actions: CONFIRM (promote to HUMAN at confidence 1; the operator now owns it) or DISMISS (state DROPPED; nothing deleted); no TARGET, no state cycle, no REMOVE, and neither action appears on HUMAN or DERIVED items
interaction.response_coverage: target signals then COVER / DEFER / REOPEN explicitly
interaction.bot_handoff: copy source-addressed agent packet; no summary-only handoff
interaction.return_resume: IMPORT RETURN restores a source-bearing comms-spine-return/v0.1 after a source/session switch; address-only receipts are deliberately not resumable
interaction.transport: RELEASE EMAIL → destination + optional subject → AUTHORIZE + COPY PACKET → OPEN MAIL CLIENT → optional exact provider receipt import → COPY VERIFIED RETURN

privacy.network_send: the web app performs no provider API send; only an explicit HUMAN_RELEASE may open the operator's external mail client with one exact payload
privacy.human_port_import: current HUMAN PORT text/JSON session object only
privacy.transport_packet: source transcript excluded; destination + response bytes/hash + source object id + release identity only

promotion_gate: core tests preserve exact source slices through parser/signals/RETURN
430×900 browser flow: demo → HUMAN mark → target ASK → draft → COVER → packet
no horizontal page overflow on phone-sized smoke
one real long messy chat: user can recover place and open obligations without reading a chapter-scroll transcript
at least one wrong derived suggestion can coexist with a corrective HUMAN mark without source mutation
non_goals: no LLM dependency for core usefulness
no replacement of HUMAN PORT, READFIELD, LACONIC, CONTINUITY or agent-router
no delivery claim without exact provider receipt
next: Use the exact transport path when a real source-addressed response is ready: explicit HUMAN_RELEASE, operator-controlled provider send, exact receipt RETURN, then let native COMMS decide signal consequence.

verification.phone_flow: 430×900 create → HUMAN mark → target ASK → draft → COVER → RETURN → source switch → resume PASS
verification.dayline_native_return: MERGED_MACHINE_GREEN · RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → OFFER_ONLY → exact native accept

changes: Added exact email transport boundary: NO_SEND candidate → explicit HUMAN_RELEASE → one exact external mail-client handoff → exact provider receipt → EVIDENCE_ONLY RETURN.
Transport packet excludes source transcript bytes; response hash/source object identity bind evidence without publishing the conversation.
Added RELEASE EMAIL deep-link entry so FIELD can reach the native transport boundary directly while COMMS retains all effect/state authority.
Added explicit OPEN-signal → Dayline handoff: prefer HUMAN-authored OPEN signal, otherwise preserve DERIVED origin visibly.
The handoff preserves source SHA, message/range address, signal kind, origin and text without transferring the full conversation.
Transport is session-local atlas-dayline-handoff/v0.1 and requires explicit ADD TO DAY; send authority remains absent.
Added explicit Dayline return OFFER consumption for the exact COMMS source signal: source SHA + signal id + message/range must all still match.
Native COMMS alone decides COVERED / DEFERRED / OPEN; Dayline never mutates communication state.
If the signal changed while away or exact address no longer resolves, the offer is stale/read-only and cannot overwrite source state.
Return transport is session-local and expires after 12 hours; dismissing an offer is lossless.

Completed source-linked Dayline objects remain returnable until one source receipt is emitted; Dayline releases focus after RETURN, preventing COMMS=COVERED while a duplicate Dayline obligation remains OPEN.

Encode the law DERIVED != HUMAN AUTHORED in the thread map itself: signal-rail ticks now carry data-origin and differ by GEOMETRY (HUMAN = full-height bar, DERIVED = half-height + dimmed), not colour alone, so the distinction survives greyscale and colour-blindness. Mirrors the existing .signalCard solid/dashed origin grammar; no new framework, no core.js change.
Extend tools/comms-spine-smoke.mjs to assert origin geometry is present and distinct, so the distinction cannot silently collapse again; the phone smoke now fails if it does.

Added a third provenance class MACHINE: a machine-spotted claim about an exact source range (confidence < 1) that is neither a weak DERIVED guess nor a HUMAN authored mark; DERIVED and HUMAN keep their exact meaning, nothing is silently promoted, and the law extends from DERIVED != HUMAN AUTHORED to DERIVED != MACHINE != HUMAN AUTHORED.

MACHINE items render distinctly in greyscale by reusing the existing origin grammar: cards carry a double left border and their signal-rail tick occupies the lower half (HUMAN = full height, DERIVED = upper half dimmed); no new colour token, no new framework.

MACHINE-origin cards expose exactly two resolving actions: CONFIRM promotes the item to origin HUMAN at confidence 1 (the operator now owns it), DISMISS sets state DROPPED and deletes nothing; neither action exists on HUMAN or DERIVED items, and a MACHINE item is not targetable, not state-cycleable and not Dayline-handoff-eligible before CONFIRM.

Machine ingress is the bounded CommsSpine.spotMachine() call: a spot must resolve its text to the exact source range, and unknown kinds or confidence 1 are rejected loudly instead of silently degrading to NOTE. Machine items and their dismissal residue survive RETURN export/import, and core tests plus the phone smoke assert presence, the two transitions, the absence of promotion paths on the other origins, and three-way origin geometry distinct in black and white.
